name: Loving Your Enemy
overview: Scripture commands believers to love their enemies actively by blessing, doing good, and praying for those who persecute or hate them, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5 and Luke 6. This love goes beyond natural affection, challenging Christians to respond with kindness without expecting anything in return, reflecting God's mercy toward the unthankful and evil. The call to love enemies underscores the universal sinfulness of all people (Romans 3:23) and distinguishes Christ’s followers by their grace-filled conduct. Such love is not only a moral duty but also a mark of being children of the Highest, promising a great reward from God.
